law_04_hybrid_map_to_cinema_bridge.live_battle_bridge: Use subtle corner Tactical Mini-Map PiP (<=15% frame area, antique-bronze frame) over live 35mm combat footage, plus smooth Map-to-Cinema Camera Dive when entering a location.

law_05_widescreen_16x9_integrity.vertical_archive_rule: Zero blind 9:16 center-crops. Use headroom-locked focal reframe (`y_anchor <= 0.15`) OR feathered 16:9 Museum Diptych staging (portrait intact on one side + aged-parchment dossier/map on opposite side).

law_10_verified_chronicle_diegetic_integ.parchment_quote_plate: Brief 3.5-4.5s aged rice-paper plate with cinnabar seal, serif typography, and subtle brush-stroke keyword underline (zero navy boxes or neon red highlight pills)
